# v3.28-dev

## What's new

- **Ignore a training entry you don't need.** Some entries simply aren't wanted — and until now the only options were to fill them in properly or delete them, losing the record that people had completed them.

  **Ignore** is available on every entry in the amber **"needs attention"** list and on every row of the main catalogue (where it applies to the whole Full Title). An ignored entry:

  - is left out of the dashboard, every report, scheduled exports and the public API;
  - is no longer offered when you're setting up program or offering requirements;
  - carries a grey **Ignored** badge so you can see the state at a glance;
  - can be **restored** at any time, from the same button or from the Full Title page.

  Nothing is deleted. The completions behind it are kept, so a learner's own record still shows the training.

- **Show ignored only.** A new tickbox beside **Show legacy only** narrows the catalogue to entries you've ignored, so you can review or restore them in one place. Like the other filters, it's remembered when you open an entry and click Back.

- **See what an unreviewed entry is costing.** The "needs attention" list has a new **Excluded** column showing how many learners have completed that training and are being held out of reporting until someone reviews it — so you can tell at a glance which entries actually matter.

## Notes

- Ignoring an entry that is *also* still unreviewed moves it out of the "needs attention" list and into the main catalogue with its badge, so it stays visible and restorable rather than disappearing from both.
- The **Ignored** state round-trips through catalogue import and export via a new **Ignored** column. Importing a file *without* that column leaves your existing ignore flags alone rather than clearing them.
